Every folder set now says, in one line, what actually backs it up.

## ✨ Added

- **Each folder set carries its resolved schedule as a sentence** ([#199](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/199)), on the Schedules card and on the Folders tab. Five outcomes: it runs on the Folders schedule, it runs on its own, it runs with Backup Everything, it runs twice, or nothing backs it up at all. The last two are the reason this exists, and they are coloured as the warnings they are.
- **"Runs twice" names both schedules**, so the second one does not have to be hunted for on another card.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A folder set could be left unprotected while looking configured.** The Folders card carries three controls that all read like scheduling, and the combination that looks most sensible is the one that protects nothing: "Include in schedule" reads as "part of the Folders schedule", but it gates the per-item entry, the Folders job **and** the Backup Everything pass, so switching it off takes the set out of every automatic backup. Nothing on screen said so. Now the set's own row does, in red.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The sentence is computed on the server**, by the same function the scheduler consults, from the same four settings, so what the card promises and what the job does cannot drift apart. A hint text can describe the rules; it cannot say what the current combination does.

## 🌐 Translations

- The five outcome sentences in all 42 languages. The names inside them come from the cards' own keys, so a set attributed to "Folders" or to "Backup Everything" follows whatever those cards are called in that language.
